notes: Rear panel (per official datasheet photo and spec tables): 4x "LINE IN" balanced euroblock inputs (3-position, 3.5mm pitch, with +/-/ground labeled), 4x "AMP OUT" speaker euroblock outputs (2-position, 5.08mm pitch, locking, "Class 2 Wiring"), 1x "GPI" port (3-position, 3.5mm euroblock; contact-closure Standby and Priority Mute functions), 1x "REMOTE LEVEL" port (7-position, 3.5mm euroblock; provides +10V/GND and a per-channel 0-10V return for remote level pots, one wired connector serving all 4 channels rather than 4 discrete ports), and IEC C14 AC mains inlet (unit ships with an IEC C13-to-NEMA 5-15 cord). No network port, no USB, no DSP/optional card slot (datasheet explicitly lists "Network: No"). Grade omitted on all ports since none are HDMI/SDI/DP/USB/Ethernet — connectors here are analog audio (euroblock) and AC power (IEC), which are outside the graded-connector list. Rack-mountable: 1RU half-rack (ships with a rack kit for single or dual half-rack mounting side by side).
